src/lib/frontend/actions/use-dismiss.sve: Sanctioned non-Bits dismissal implementation; see this file's header comment. Dismisses outside clicks while preserving interactions that began inside and respecting ignored nodes.
Sanctioned non-Bits dismissal implementation; see this file's header comment. Handles Escape for the topmost enabled dismisser, with opt-out and IME guards.
Sanctioned non-Bits dismissal implementation; see this file's header comment. Records where an interaction began so its subsequent click does not dismiss a surface it started inside.
src/lib/frontend/components/file/FileVie: Escape-key handler registered only while the file viewer is visible; prevents default and clears the viewer through handleClose. No global outside-click or focus model, though this is independent Escape dismissal retained as existing behavior.
src/lib/frontend/components/input/InputA: Escape keyboard shortcut navigates back to the parent session only with empty input and neither command nor file menu visible. It performs session navigation, not overlay dismissal or focus management.
src/lib/frontend/components/layout/ChatL: Window shortcuts toggle debug and select session views. They do not implement outside-click or Escape dismissal.
src/lib/frontend/components/layout/Sessi: Mounted session bar handles transcript verb letters and global session shortcuts. It does not implement outside-click or Escape dismissal.
src/lib/frontend/components/model/AgentS: Hand-rolled outside-click model that duplicates use-dismiss, checking trigger and portal containment before closing. Pinned only so the ratchet can be turned on today; migration is tracked as conduit-test-79hj.

Escape closing plus ArrowUp/ArrowDown navigation and Enter selection belong to the hand-rolled outside-click model that duplicates use-dismiss. Pinned only so the ratchet can be turned on today; migration is tracked as conduit-test-79hj.
src/lib/frontend/components/model/ModelV: Ctrl+T keyboard shortcut cycles model variants when variants exist. It changes the selected variant and implements no dismissal or focus model.
src/lib/frontend/components/overlays/Con: Not a dismissal: Enter confirms the open dialog. Acts only when the event target is the confirm <dialog> itself, so focused buttons keep their own Enter and Escape stays with Dialog.
src/lib/frontend/components/overlays/Rew: Existing svelte:window listener exits rewind mode on Escape while the banner is visible and its modal is closed. Svelte owns listener teardown.
src/lib/frontend/components/project/Proj: The mounted panel's svelte:window handler cancels the add-project form first on Escape, otherwise calls onclose. Both hosts retain use-dismiss with escape: false for outside clicks; Svelte owns keydown listener teardown.
src/lib/frontend/components/session/Deep: Cmd/Ctrl+K opens deep search (or refocuses its input). An open shortcut only; the search dialog is dismissed by ui/Modal.
src/lib/frontend/components/session/Sess: Tracks which session row holds keyboard focus so the list shortcuts act on it. Records focus only; dismisses nothing.

Session-list keyboard shortcuts (row verbs, ? help, Cmd+Z undo of the last toast action), inert in editable fields and while a dialog or menu is open. Its one Escape case leaves select mode and only fires with focus inside #session-list; it closes no overlay.
Clears the keyboard-focused row on any pointer press so a stale keyboard target cannot linger once the mouse or finger takes over. Dismisses nothing.

Not a dismissal. Two global shortcuts into the session search field: `/` focuses it (skipped inside editable targets) and Cmd/Ctrl+P opens the project scope picker. Pointer devices only, skips modifier combos it does not own, and respects defaultPrevented.
src/lib/frontend/components/ui/Dialog.sv: Records keyboard modality before a conditional dialog mounts so first-option focus stays visible for keyboard opens. Does not dismiss or handle Escape.
Records pointer modality before a conditional dialog mounts so its first option does not show a keyboard focus ring. Does not dismiss or handle outside presses.
